item.title: Why Medical Report Generation Needs Role-Asymmetric Agents
item.description: The goal is not to ask two agents the same question. It is to assign different clinical risks: one prioritizes recall, while the other controls false positives.

item.title: From Benchmark to Production Gate: Why “Faster” Is Not Yet Deployable
item.description: A compelling speedup is not enough. Production readiness must cover latency, memory, quality, and stability together.
